The AI Editor is a built-in content editor in SEOwind that lets you refine and polish your articles directly after generation. It works like a standard text editor but includes AI-powered tools to help you improve content faster.

You can make edits manually or use AI prompts to:

- Expand ideas

- Rewrite content for clarity

- Shorten text

- Humanize AI-generated content


The editor includes an assistant where you can give custom instructions, such as simplifying a sentence, changing tone, or improving a paragraph. You can type directly what you want the AI to do.

It also supports basic editing actions like undo, redo, and formatting, similar to Google Docs, so it’s easy to use even if you’re not used to AI tools.

![seowind AI editor](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/AIE1-1024x555.png)

### **AI Humanizer** [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/ai-editor/\#0-toc-title)

The AI Editor includes a “Humanize” feature that rewrites your entire article to sound more natural and engaging. This is helpful if the content feels too robotic or AI-like.

### **How to access the AI Editor** [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/ai-editor/\#1-toc-title)

After generating an article with SEOwind, it opens automatically in the AI Editor.You can also access it later by clicking on **Open AI Article** from the dashboard.
